title: ELSS lots allotted on four dates incl. 29-Feb-2024 and 31-Mar/31-Dec: first redeemable day after the 3-year lock-in
covers: General Clauses Act s.9 'from' excludes first day
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.80C(2)(xiii) and the Equity Linked Saving Scheme, 2005 (Ministry of Finance notification of 3-Nov-2005; S.O. number recalled as 1563(E), not verified): units locked in for three years from the date of allotment
General Clauses Act 1897 s.9: in a period expressed as 'from' a day, the first day is excluded; s.3(66): 'year' = year reckoned by the British calendar
Brief convention (example 2023-01-10 -> 2026-01-11): first redeemable day = anniversary + 1 day
derivation: 2023-01-10: period starts 2023-01-11, three years end 2026-01-10 -> redeemable from 2026-01-11.

2024-02-29: period starts 2024-03-01; three calendar years later the period ends on the day before 2027-03-01, i.e. 2027-02-28 -> redeemable from 2027-03-01. (Alternative reading: treat 2027-03-01 as the 'anniversary' of 29-Feb and add a day -> 2027-03-02. The first reading is preferred because counting from the excluded first day 2024-03-01 needs no leap-day roll; marked interpretive.)
No sales -> no disposals and no FY blocks; all four lots remain open at cost.
